craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 32. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: In that body but some of his arises: supreme Śāṅkara grace, from root and from knowledge or from served teacher.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tasmindehe tu kāpyasya jāyate śāṅkarī parā bhaktirūhācca vijñānādācāryādvāpyasevitāt
